title: hemionitis columbina
intro: Hemionitis columbina, commonly known as the Lady fern or Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which aid in wound healing and reducing swelling. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis columbina include antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, which help protect against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
